item1.reason: The patient says the radio made the sound less distracting and allowed them to finish sorting.

evidence.quote: Then I turned on the radio. It made it less distracting, and I carried on until I’d finished sorting.

item2.reason: “Too slow” comments on the patient’s pace rather than giving an instruction.

evidence.quote: I was sorting sewing supplies at home and heard a voice say “too slow.” It happened on two evenings last week.
